la Bordeta — Barcelona, Spain

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Documented trouble in la Bordeta centers on one nightlife venue ('Genius Bar', formerly La Choza), where neighbours reported frequent fights, drug consumption/trafficking, and assaults on police. A joint Mossos/Guardia Urbana operation in July 2024 made arrests. No wider pattern of assault or robbery across the rest of the barri was found; the concern is localized to nightlife around that specific address. Sources checked: Metrópoli Abierta, July 2024.
